method: Keyword and regex rules in agents/text/themes.py, documented in agents/text/codebook.md. Multi-label. Filler comments are coded only as no_substantive. A non-match is other_unclear. No network and no API key. Percents use non-empty comments as the denominator and are rounded half-to-even to 1 decimal. Groups with n < 10 are suppressed. County, role, and training-period levels with n < 10 are pooled into other_pooled. English and Spanish stay separate.

pii_screen.method: Regex on each non-empty comment for an email, a separated phone number (10-digit or 7-digit), a school phrase including 'my school', an honorific plus a capitalized name, 'my name is', or a role word such as trainer plus a capitalized name. 988 is not treated as a phone number. Names with no honorific and no role word are missed. n_flagged counts comment fields, not rows. Quotes still require human review.

spanish.handling: Spanish phrases are in the same offline rules. Rows with language es and a non-empty comment are counted here and reported as their own language group. If that group has n < 10, its counts are suppressed.

validation.procedure: Text agent hand-coded a stratified sample, seed 17, from the codebook, without printing the classifier labels for those rows. Every non-empty Spanish comment is included, plus 25 English comments per field drawn from response ids sorted and shuffled with seed 17. Labels are response id and theme ids only, in gitignored data/processed/hand_labels.json. agreement_pct is exact theme-set match. cohen_kappa is the unweighted mean of per-theme binary Cohen's kappas on the sample. The same agent wrote the rules and the labels, so this is a consistency check, not an independent second coder. Exact set match on this sample was 75.0 before a follow-up pass added phrases the codebook already covered and the rules missed. The agreement_pct below is after that pass, on the same sample, so it is not a locked test.
